name: Bachelor Point
description: Four young men from different districts of Bangladesh encounter various challenges as they try to live an independent life in the city, Dhaka.

videos.title: Bachelor Trip
videos.overview: The bachelors from Bachelor Point are back but this time on a one day trip to a resort in Gazipur. There they meet three girls who turned out to be goons.

videos.title: Bachelor Quarantine
videos.overview: The bachelors are back, but this time trying to figure out Lockdown or Quarantine. They are also trying to get out Pasha Bhai out of the house so that they can take a nice breath.

videos.title: Bachelor's Ramadan
videos.overview: The bachelors are back, this time in Ramadan season. The time of getting holy and pure, the bachelors try and complete all their 30 fasting days alongside their hilarious nuisances.

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: All of the characters in this series gets introduced. Everyone has one thing in common - Problems.

videos.title: Classroom
videos.overview: Today is everyone's first class at their varsity. All the students gets introduced, and the whole class gets disturbed by Kabila and Shuvo.

videos.title: Bharatiya
videos.overview: All the newcomers have problems for a place to stay. Story 1 : Nabila offers the American-Bangladeshi student Nehal to stay at her house. Story 2 : Shuvo and Kabila finds a place to stay at a short-tempered guy named Habu Bhai.

videos.title: Bua na Apa
videos.overview: Story 1 : Kabila and Shuvo are just making fun of the building-owner's daughter and mocking her. Story 2 : Shamim disrespects the house-help and she tends to leave the place.

videos.title: New Student
videos.overview: Story 1 : A new student comes to the class, Kabila and Shuvo tries to flirt with the newcomer. Story 2 : Nehal impresses the flat-owner and Habu Bhai with his gentle behavior, and pays the rent in advance.

videos.title: Suspect and Respect
videos.overview: Story 1 : As Shuvo is older, he tends to need more respect. But Habu Bhai scolds him for his attitude. Story 2 : Nirala likes Nabila's new tutor and tries to flirt with him, so they're father suspects them.

videos.title: Mentality
videos.overview: Story 1 : Kabila annoys everyone with his late-night calls with his crush. Story 2 : Nehal tries to change the behavior of Shuvo and Kabila.

videos.title: Phone Nikhoj
videos.overview: Story 1 : Nehal cannot sleep in his room because of Habu Bhai's snoring. Story 2 : Shamim cannot find his phone after waking up, and tells that he has been robbed.

videos.title: Rivalry
videos.overview: Story 1 : The trio, Nafisa, Nabila and Nirala all like the new tutor and they all fight over this. Story 2 : Nehal, the newcomer, has been accused of stealing Arefin's phone, and discusses with Habu Bhai about it.

videos.title: Chor
videos.overview: Arefin has found his phone, but Kabila is not satisfied until he finds the actual thief.

videos.title: Date
videos.overview: Story 1 : The oldest sister, Nirala, goes on a date with the tutor. The whole family seemed to be shocked and are blaming the other two sisters. Story 2 : Nehal buys a phone for Arefin, but Arefin already found his old phone.

videos.title: Ritual
videos.overview: Story 1 : All the 4 bachelors try to find out the phone thief by performing a ritual. Story 2 : Arefin's father calls him when he is sick, but Arefin will not answer him whatsoever.

videos.title: Earthquake
videos.overview:
Story 1 : For the first time, Habu Bhai has got up from his bed. He starts to peek their daily house-help, Miss Rehana.

Story 2 : An earthquake occurs, Kabila and Nehal ignores it thinking that it's Habu Bhai turning in sleep.

videos.title: Party
videos.overview:
Story 1 : The bachelors host a party at their apartment and invites Nafisa too.

Story 2 : After the earthquake, the pillars of the building seems to break apart. They invite them to stay with the house-owners at Dhanmondi.

videos.title: Hangover
videos.overview: The bachelors were really hungover because of the party, Shuvo's father pays an unexpected visit to their flat. Kabila, thinking that the idea of fooling someone's father is not right, tells every bad habit that Shuvo has.

videos.title: Hangover - Part 2
videos.overview: Story 1 : Nabila tells to their parents about Nafisa going to the bachelor party. Her parents scolds her a lot. Story 2 : After Kabila tells Shuvo's father about Shuvo's bad habits, his father decides to make Kabila his guardian.

videos.title: Snake
videos.overview: Story 1 : Nafisa, being scolded by her mother, complains her father about her mother's unnecessary scolding. Story 2 : Arefin calls Tawsif about his incident, and says about leaving Dhaka for a couple of days.

videos.title: Fever
videos.overview: Story 1 : Nabila pretends she has a fever, so that she can be saved from the scoldings. Story 2 : Shuvo's father cannot sleep because of Habu Bhai's snoring, so he repeatedly splashed him with water.

videos.title: Snoring
videos.overview: Story 1 : Because of Habu Bhai's snoring, Shuvo's father kicks him out of the room. But the other bachelors won't let Habu Bhai sleep with them. Story 2 : Nabila's tutor goes on a date with someone else, instead of Nirala.

videos.title: Guardian
videos.overview: Story 1 : Shuvo's father makes Kabila Shuvo's Guardian, and Shuvo and Kabila's rivalry starts. Story 2 : Kabila accidentally goes to the female washroom, and the university students are getting furious about it.

videos.title: Bully
videos.overview: Story 1 : Kabila accidentally goes to the female toilet, and the university students started bullying him. Story 2 : Because of Habu Bhai's different country visa's, he has to attend a meeting with an associate.

videos.title: Taka
videos.overview: Story 1 : Habu Bhai's foreigner friend is coming, as he is broke he asks every bachelor for money. Story 2 : Nirala, is going to a business trip in Australia, Nafisa and her mother plans on making a list of all the foreign makeup supplies.

videos.title: Rokeya
videos.overview: Story 1 : Kabila's lover, Rokeya, is seeing some other guy named Zakir and tries to hit another guy named Zakir. Story 2 : Kabila is telling her father asked about the party that happened couple days ago, and says everything about Nafisa.

videos.title: Citizen
videos.overview: Story 1 : Nehal, gets invited to Habu Bhai's close friend's office for getting 'entertained' by four women. Story 2 : Nafisa's mother gets very upset when she hears about Nafisa's secrets, and calls Kabila to her home to discuss it.

videos.title: Bidesh
videos.overview: When Habu Bhai's travel agent came, everyone's been very excited to talk to the person for requesting them to take them to a foreign country.

videos.title: Sleepover
videos.overview: Zakir, the travel agent, sleeps with Habu for the rest of the night, but couldn't sleep because of his snoring. When he went to the bachelors' room, he had to sleep on the floor.

videos.title: Low Pressure
videos.overview: Nehal found a girl having an headache near the elevator, and he brought her to their bachelor apartment so that she can relax. But when the other bachelors' saw the girl they were saying Nehal that this is a bad idea.

videos.title: Money Lending
videos.overview: Story 1 : Kabila complains about the low pressure girl and says bunch of lies about that incident to look heroic. Story 2 : Kabila borrows a lot of money from Nehal, Shuvo says that Kabila lends a lot of money and he is a cheapskate.

videos.title: Australia
videos.overview: Story 1 : Kabila and Shuvo both talk to Liona about not to interfere between Nabila and Nehal. Story 2 : Nirala is going to Australia for a business trip, her mother and Nafisa both have listed all the necessities that she has to bring.

videos.title: Foreigner
videos.overview: Nehal's foreigner friend Linda comes to Bangladesh for an NGO, Nehal brings her to the bachelor point to meet the other bachelors. Kabila and Shuvo were too hyper to meet her.

videos.title: American Girl
videos.overview: Nehal and Linda are stopped by some local hooligans and they tell to sit with Linda, Nehal calls the other bachelors' to help him. But they all bail out on him after they see the gang.

videos.title: Propose
videos.overview: Nabila and Kabila had a conversation about Nehal having a crush on Nabila, Nabila is very excited to get proposed by Nehal. But Kabila said that maybe Linda and Nehal are husband-wife and flee to Bangladesh and hid their identities.

videos.title: Friendship
videos.overview: All 4 friends have a brotherly relationship after the hooligan incident. Both Kabila and Shuvo aren't rivals anymore, but they still can't figure out the relationship of Nehal and Linda.

videos.title: Affair
videos.overview: Story 1 : Because of Elvin staying at her brother's house, her wife can't have an affair with her lover nor can meet him. Story 2 : Nehal decided to share his bed with Shojib, but Shojib keeps staring at him.

videos.title: Habu's Roommate
videos.overview: After kicking Shojib out of their room, Arefin said him to stay with Habu Bhai. But Shojib tries to disrespect him a lot and kicks him out of his room too.

videos.title: Suspect
videos.overview: Story 1 : Kabila and Shuvo both thrash Shojib for being too touchy. Story 2 : Elvin's brother starts to suspect that guy that comes frequently during his office hours.

videos.title: Renting Rant
videos.overview: All 4 bachelors go around Dhaka to find a house that they can rent. Due to the earthquake that occured couple months ago, thus they have to leave the current flat.

videos.title: Settled
videos.overview: All the bachelors are getting settled with the new house. At night, during the outing, Kabila and Shuvo says bad things about Nehal, and as a friend, Arefin scolds both of them.

videos.title: Ragging
videos.overview: All the bachelors start to rag Habu because during their previous house days, Habu was the senior and had his own room. This time Habu didn't pay a single penny and they are all ragging because of Habu's older scoldings.

videos.title: Bhai Brother
videos.overview: The hooligans' gang leader came to their new house for tour, everyone is praising that guy but Arefin has some problems because the guy insulted everyone in the past and everyone's respecting him still.

videos.title: Fake Fever
videos.overview: During no one's home, Habu called Miss Rehana to accompany her. But during the perfect moment, all the bachelors arrive home and find Habu suffering from fever. Everyone's stuff is missing and find all their stuff with Habu.

videos.title: The Mistress
videos.overview: Kabila found out about Nabila's father's mistress. He discusses this with the bachelors and they said to keep it private. Shuvo tells this to Nabila causing a big mishap.

videos.title: The Mishap
videos.overview: Story 1 : Nabila's mother interrogated his husband and started a strict surveillance under him. Story 2 : Habu Bhai cannot broom the floor nice enough, Kabila teaches him as well as brooms the whole floor as an explanation.

videos.title: Chill
videos.overview: The hooligan leader bought her girlfriend to the bachelor house to have some fun, all the bachelors' try to hear and see what's happening inside the room and get busted.

videos.title: Affair Story
videos.overview: Story 1 : Kabila talks with Rokeya at midnight, because of calling Habu Bhai got awoken and disturbs' the call. Story 2 : Kabila tells Nabila about the detailed story of her father's date affair.

videos.title: Zakir
videos.overview: At night, Kabila saw a nightmare were her girlfriend Rokeya was occupied with someone named Zakir. Nehal was also took by that manpower officer named Zakir for sending them to the U.S.

videos.title: Confession
videos.overview: Habu Bhai confesses the fact that he has no respect given by the bachelors', he says Arefin and Nehal to give him some respect as he is older than everyone.

videos.title: Choto Bhai
videos.overview: Shuvo's childhood friend has come to Dhaka to meet Shuvo and stay with him for a couple days. But Kabila is not satisfied that a stranger is living at a bachelor home for free.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Shuvo's childhood friend Naeem, is ordering Habu unnecessarily, and disrespecting him a lot. Arefin and Nehal are very upset of the fact that an outsider is commanding a poor guy like Habu.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Pasha Bhai orders everyone and if no one listens to him or abuses Habu Bhai, he gets very angry and tends to show his gun in their foreheads. Nafisa and Nabila quarrels about having a new home tutor and says that he should be handsome.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Pasha Bhai wants to eat ladyfingers but Kabila thinks that he needs a lady. Shuvo asks money from Pasha Bhai, after checking Shuvo's moneybag he found more than the money he requested.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Pasha Bhai gets very lonely all the time, during loneliness he just makes the house untidy in anger. So he called the bachelors' to clean the house.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Pasha Bhai orders the other bachelors' to stay with him so that he doesn't feel lonely, he commands everyone to do various works. Pasha Bhai also wants to sleep with which reminds him of the jail days.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Pasha Bhai orders Arifin to shave his facial hair. Kabila finally video calls Rokeya and is surprised to see her completely changed. All the bachelors' decide to setup goons for Pasha Bhai so that he can leave.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Nehal bribes Pasha Bhai some money and asks him to leave. Habu Bhai is said to have checked every house-help's cooking hand, Pasha Bhai hires a part time house-help because of Habu Bhai.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: The bachelors can't find Pasha Bhai when they wake up in the morning. The bachelors decided to buy some alcohol but get arrested.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: After the 4 bachelors get arrested, Habu Bhai calls everyone's parents and informs them to bail them out. When Nabila gets to know about it, she has a complete breakdown.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Habu Bhai first brings food for the bachelors and begs the officers to spare them. After checking the alcohol bottle they find out that its just a mixture of Coca-Cola and Sprite, Habu Bhai slaps everyone as punishments.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: After the alcohol incident, one of their classmates tend to tease them about the incident. The 4 bachelors started to beat up the guy, the guy brought a whole gang to beat the bachelors up, but they somehow get saved.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: The bachelors wants a new maid, but Habu Bhai took it too seriously and made posters and pasted it to walls around their area. Pasha Bhai gets very upset when he sees all this.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Pasha Bhai has brought some Dragon tea from a super-shop, when he drinks that tea, Arifin, Kabila and Habu also come in the line to drink this tea. Kabila and Arifin is drinking this because they are getting high by it.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: The hooligan gang leader is back with another one of his girlfriends to chill in one of their rooms. But this time Pasha Bhai slapped that gang leader and even steals his girl.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: The person who ragged Nehal, gets re-ragged by Pasha Bhai and the other bachelors. The hooligans' leader wants to rent the single-bedroom house at the posh area.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: The bachelors are losing money because of Pasha Bhai, so they decided to make an ad for a new tenant. So that they can pay for Pasha Bhai's daily necessities.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: The new tenant Audit is teaching Habu Bhai and Kabila some dance steps so that they can lose some weight. Kabila tells a made up story about Nafisa's father drinking alcohol and video calling girls to Nafisa's mother.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Audit feeds everyone sweets because of his casting in a web-series, but they all hate the plot. Nafisa and her mother asks his father about the alcohol incident, but refuses.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Adit talks about two roles for a TV program for Shuvo and Kabila, but Kabila instantly says no because of his before failed web-series. The bachelors' neighbor Riya barges in their home because her sister-in-law scolded her.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Riya is sad, so everyone tries to cheer her up. Meanwhile, Arifin took Riya on a Rickshaw ride and street food eating. Habu Bhai goes to buy some stuff for someone. But he spends all the money on food and tells Audit that it got stolen.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Shuvo asks about the models during the shoot and asks him to have a party with them. Kabila asks Riya to participate on a music video that his director friend will direct.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: Everyone is giving ideas about Audit's TV or movie roles, Kabila gives an emotional story and Shuvo gives a story about a person with discount problems. When Habu Bhai was asked about Audit's rent, he said that it all got spent.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: Pasha Bhai arrives from Kashimpur, and gives a tight welcome slap to Audit because of misbehaving. Pasha Bhai wants to see some live acting, he made Audit the male character and Habu Bhai the uncle character.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: The whole episode revolves around Arifin taking too much time in bathroom, Kabila and Shuvo are suspecting that he's talking to Riya at the toilet.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Pasha Bhai wants to drink some Dragon tea, he asks Audit this time, and he got really excited because it will help him lose weight. Kabila wants Audit to make a call to Rokeya so that he can see how Rokeya talks to strangers.

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: Kabila gets very angry about the Rokeya incident, so he gets drunk and says bad stuff about Pasha Bhai for being too arrogant. Kabila later says that its all a joke and his main motive was to feel sympathized about the bachelors.

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: Kabila says all the habits about Bacchu the hooligan gang leader and also says not to give him the rent for the room. Pasha Bhai and Riya plays chess while others are making Dragon tea and ordering pizza for them.

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: Kabila and Arefin both talk to RIya about the Music Video incident and both of them says to confront Kabila. Kabila asks about the obnoxious noises that come Arifin's bed and says that he shouldn't be too loud to disturb someone.

videos.title: Episode 34
videos.overview: Pasha Bhai suggests a story for Audit's TV program which is based on Pasha Bhai's actual prison story. Kabila's right hand man Hunter Janwar is coming to their apartment to stay for a few days, and has warned some basic rules.

videos.title: Episode 35
videos.overview: Shuvo tries to learn English and is trying to talk in English with everyone. Kabila scolds Rokeya a lot after that Prank Call incident, she sent a picture of her hand carved out in the letter K.

videos.title: Episode 36
videos.overview: Shuvo tries to learn English, but Kabila thinks that he's being too stupid not learning a proper Bengali accent. Shuvo teaches some English to Habu Bhai also.

videos.title: Episode 37
videos.overview: Shuvo taught Habu Bhai a bad phrase. Now, he's telling everyone that phrase and is getting cussed a lot.

videos.title: Episode 38
videos.overview: Kabila suggests a story about a couple who has a commitment of not eating any sour food in their lifetime. But she still cheats on her husband with some tamarind. Habu Bhai cannot afford to go abroad and can't pay more money to Zakir.

videos.title: Episode 39
videos.overview: Pasha Bhai calls her female friend so that he can talk with her and apply henna on his head. Pasha Bhai insistently takes money from Nehal for henna.

videos.title: Episode 40
videos.overview: Arifin wants to borrow Kabila's sunglasses, but Kabila says he can take but he has to pay a hourly rent. Arifin just goes out the door without saying anything. When Shuvo gets to know this, he says that he will go with Arifin.

videos.title: Episode 41
videos.overview: Shuvo follows Arifin to wherever he goes, but finds out that he's on a date with Riya. Shuvo calls everyone and starts crying. Pasha Bhai has a lot of money remaining but all are going on Shuvo's tab and he pays none.

videos.title: Episode 42
videos.overview: Shuvo and Arifin has now created a sort of rivalry between them, because Arifin went on a date with Riya. Habu Bhai still hasn't gone to Qatar because of Zakir's con game, so Pasha Bhai decided to hit him and get the remaining money.

videos.title: Episode 43
videos.overview: Habu Bhai and Riya are on a Rickshaw ride, Shuvo sees it and consults other bachelors about it. Audit tells everything about the fake police invasion that occurred couple days ago.

videos.title: Episode 44
videos.overview: Kabila's uncle got a promotion in RAB. Pasha and Habu Bhai are very shocked to hear that and will listen to all the orders of the bachelors. Kabila confronts Habu Bhai on taking Riya on a ride.

videos.title: Episode 45
videos.overview: Shuvo got senseless when he saw Kabila and Riya eating street food together. Everyone loves Riya except Nehal and Habu Bhai, Habu Bhai loves Rehana the servant.

videos.title: Episode 46
videos.overview: Rokeya wrote a K on her hand, now K can mean a lot of things. So he calls her in the middle of her class to make her say the truth. Now every bachelor knows about it.

videos.title: Episode 47
videos.overview: Everyone has lost hope on Riya because Pasha Bhai wants to marry Riya and said the bachelors to plan a wedding. Shuvo was shocked to see that everyone is so eager to attend the wedding.

videos.title: Episode 48
videos.overview: Shuvo is devastated to know that no one is home, but he gets to know Pasha Bhai is now in Kashimpur. Kabila's right hand man Hunter Janwar has come to their apartment.

videos.title: Episode 49
videos.overview: Kabila's friend Hunter Janwar has come unannounced, so Kabila kicks him out of the house house. Shuvo has decided to take someone to the shopping mall with him, but no one will go except Habu Bhai.

videos.title: Episode 50
videos.overview: Habu told the bad worth to Riya's sister-in-law, and the landlord decided to let them go of the apartment. Arifin's father wants to discuss with him about property, but he isn't interested in property or marriage.

videos.title: Episode 51
videos.overview: Pasha Bhai confronts Shuvo about the disgusting behavior that Habu Bhai did with Riya's sister-in-law. Habu Bhai gave a million Taka to Zakir but still hasn't gone to Qatar, so he consults the bachelors about it.

videos.title: Episode 52
videos.overview: Nehal finds a very nice house with a rooftop apartment for the same price and features of the older apartment. All the bachelors go for a haircut, but Kabila and Shuvo doesn't want one because its too expensive.

videos.title: Episode 53
videos.overview: Habu Bhai did a full body oil massage without telling anyone and puts the money on Nehal's tab. Meanwhile, they all have the same problem adjusting in the new house as they had from the old apartment.

videos.title: Episode 54
videos.overview: Pasha Bhai has come from Kashimpur, he didn't like the new house they rented. Pasha Bhai and Kabila are talking about some kind of deal where they will benefit 500K each. But Shuvo hears all of their conversation, now he wants a share.

videos.title: Episode 55
videos.overview: The African-Bangladeshi hotel manager is back in search for a job, but Kabila has a plan of making Pasha Bhai let go of their apartment. They are teaching what to reply when Pasha Bhai says anything.

videos.title: Episode 56
videos.overview: The African-Bangladeshi guy is here to scare Pasha Bhai as a Jamaican don. Shuvo arrives and meets with the guy, he was shocked to see how an hotel manager got into cheap paid acting.

videos.title: Episode 57
videos.overview: The manager guy had passed a complete night sleeping beside his fear, Pasha Bhai. At morning, he wanted to go to the rooftop with Arefin to cut the stress. But now he's a changed man with full confidence.

videos.overview: Pasha Bhai has been chased all day by Dogba, Pasha Bhai is very stressed because Dogba sleeps in Pasha Bhai's bed. He said to the bachelors but they can't do anything.

videos.title: Episode 60
videos.overview: After Kabila got expelled, Habu repeatedly teases him for cheating on an exam. Drogba has been living in their house for 4 days without salary, so they decided to pay 500 Taka per bachelor.

videos.title: Episode 61
videos.overview: Shuvo got a part-time job at a call center and has bought rotten sweets for everyone by mistake. Pasha and Drogba both have the nightmare of getting killed by their opposites.

videos.title: Episode 62
videos.overview: Nehal bought a t-shirt for Habu Bhai, and he hugs him very tightly. Arifin collects the monthly meal money from everyone, Habu Bhai has eaten Kabila's meal, so he goes and buys some food.

videos.title: Episode 63
videos.overview: Habu Bhai has brought stale rice for Kabila to eat and he gets very angry and feeds it to Habu Bhai. Riya has come to visit them after settling in their new house, Nehal has decided to treat everyone in restaurant.

videos.title: Episode 64
videos.overview: Riya had to leave for some circumstances, when Shuvo and Pasha gets to know about it they get very sad. Mr. Sajjad has come to their house to have a look at how the bachelors are doing.

videos.title: Episode 65
videos.overview: Kabila is still angry about Turjo telling the examiner about Kabila's cheating on the BBA examination. So, Kabila has decided to attend the examination again but this time making Pasha Bhai his guardian.

videos.overview: Kabila brought Pasha and Habu Bhai as his cousins for guardians, so that he can reappear in the examination. Kabila has a quarrel with his little brother and friend, Shimul. The next scene he appears at the bachelor house.

videos.title: Episode 67
videos.overview: Kabila gets very angry that Shimul came to their house without any notice, but got happy when he heard that he can scare Pasha Bhai with just his boots which he stole from a Senior Inspector.

videos.title: Episode 68
videos.overview: Shimul is trying to befriend with the bachelors, but his mentality is really weird for all of them. Kabila gets very angry whenever Shimul talked about stealing or theft. Nabila gets to know about Kabila cheating on the exam.

videos.title: Episode 69
videos.overview: Shimul is still trying to get befriend with the bachelors but can't do it. He says that he wants to go to the roof with Arefin but when Kabila heard about it he scolded both of them.

videos.title: Episode 71
videos.overview: Shimul tries and gets friendly with everyone but can't befriend because of his loose character. Kabila and Rokeya discuss about their future and how many kids they will take.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Arefin and Nehal are gone now and because of emptiness, Habu wants to sleep with them. Zakir comes into business and Kabila sees him and Zakir tells him to calm down and sit at a restaurant, but all of them leave without paying the bill.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Kabila tells Pasha Bhai and Habu Bhai about Zakir and how he stole a lot of money from Habu Bhai. Shuvo tells Shimul to stay with them at the bachelor home for the daily house errands and cleaning purposes.

videos.overview: Habu Bhai catches one of Zakir's female assistants and tells Kabila to come, but they all melt when they saw the girl. Pasha took her home and Shuvo thinks that he did the girl.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Habu Bhai takes an interview of various different maids when Kabila and Shuvo are out. When they come back they tell nasty lies about Habu Bhai and scares the maids away.

videos.overview: Rehana got married. Habu Bhai is really sad that she married and didn't keep her promise. Pasha Bhai came to see a women at the roof, but Kabila says that the women's husband is an army officer and the place is under surveillance.

videos.overview: Shuvo is practicing for TOEFL now and Habu Bhai wants to learn English too. This time also Shuvo teaches Habu Bhai more foul language rather than the correct one.

videos.overview: After chasing the maid with a knife, Pagla Sujon gets caught by everyone. Meanwhile, Motlob’s money mix-up creates chaos, and the maid threatens to bomb the bachelor house!

videos.title: Episode 42
videos.overview: The bachelors hold a court over Pagla Sujon and the maid’s chaos, while Motlob’s X-ray drama and Pasha Bhai’s new plan add to the laughter and madness!

videos.title: Episode 43
videos.overview: Hearing Kabila’s uncle is a RAB officer, Pagla Sujon runs away in fear! Meanwhile, chaos returns to the bachelor house with Bua, Jakir, and Motlob’s funny mischiefs.

videos.title: Episode 44
videos.overview: After a long time, Bachchu Bhai returns and talks about investing in the underworld, shocking everyone! Later, at Kaka-Kaki’s house, he looks for a place to keep his money—while Bua tries to take her chance.

videos.title: Episode 45
videos.overview: Motlob takes money from Bachchu Bhai for his wife’s treatment, while chaos erupts as Bua is accused of stealing. Meanwhile, Bachchu Bhai chills on the street with his gang, and Pasha Bhai tries to help Nehal with some cash.

videos.title: Episode 46
videos.overview: While delivering boxers, Pasha Bhai tries to treat Kabila to soup, and back home, Bua secretly eats the chicken leg! Meanwhile, Bachchu Bhai enjoys a resort hangout, joined by the bachelors for a lavish lunch.

videos.title: Episode 47
videos.overview: The bachelors enjoy swimming and dinner with Bachchu Bhai at the resort, but the fun turns to chaos at night when thieves break in, knock everyone out with spray, and steal everything!

videos.title: Episode 48
videos.overview: The bachelors interrogate Motlob over the theft, while Jakir enjoys a fun day out with Lamia. But just then, a beautiful girl walks into the bachelor flat—leaving Pasha Bhai completely stunned!

videos.title: Episode 49
videos.overview: While searching for Zayef, his aunt visits the bachelor house. There, she meets Pasha Bhai and Kabila, who try to help her. Pasha Bhai even brings her a cup of coffee himself, making her feel welcomed.

videos.title: Episode 50
videos.overview: After Pasha Bhai meets Sporsho, his behavior starts to change, and Kabila and Nehal tease him about it at the bachelor house. Meanwhile, Bachchu Bhai is seen chatting with an unfamiliar girl at his own home!

videos.title: Episode 51
videos.overview: After the burglary at the bachelor house, Shuvo video-calls Kabila and Nehal to check in and asks them to send a new phone for Kabila. Meanwhile, Habu asks the maid to cook hilsa fish — but Miss Lovely ends up eating it all.

videos.title: Episode 52
videos.overview: After the burglary, Nehal brings an iPhone from America for Kabila, who shows it to Pasha Bhai to make him jealous. Nehal also secretly gives Habu 20,000 taka to buy a phone.

videos.title: Episode 53
videos.overview: Sporsho sits in Pasha Bhai’s room, chatting with him, while Kabila, Nehal, Habu, and Zakir try to figure out what’s happening from outside. Later, at the zoo, the bachelors unexpectedly run into Sporsho and Zayef.

videos.title: Episode 54
videos.overview: As the bachelors prepare to leave the zoo, they meet Sparsho and Zaif. Kabira, Pasha, Habu, and Zakir persuade Nehal to explore the zoo again, while Tiger Zakir asks him for a photo with the tiger.

videos.title: Episode 55
videos.overview: After the zoo visit, Habu Bhai treats everyone. Malu Dalal reveals the MD of LogeAchi.com’s personal issue, which soon makes headlines about Bacchu Sir’s private matter.

videos.title: Episode 56
videos.overview: Miss Lovely visits Nehal to learn English before going to America. After seeing Bacchu Sir’s personal news in the paper, Zakir and the bachelors visit him at his home.

videos.title: Episode 57
videos.overview: Kabila questions Bachchu Bhai about hiring Antora, while Habu asks Nehal to look for a suitable bride for him. Meanwhile, Nehal gifts Pasha Bhai a laptop—leaving Kabila asking Nehal why he bought it.

videos.title: Episode 58
videos.overview: Sporsho sends an apology cake to the bachelors, which Pasha, Zakir, and Habu quickly finish. Later, Pasha Bhai asks Kabila to suggest Bachchu Bhai invest in the underworld, while Bachchu confirms Antora’s job.

videos.title: Episode 59
videos.overview: At night, Kabila catches Zakir, Habu, and Pasha Bhai for eating the cake and scolds everyone. Meanwhile, Nehal teaches Lovely Buya English, discusses Antora’s job with Shuvo alongside Kabila, and Rokia’s cousin Rocky visits the house.

videos.title: Episode 60
videos.overview: Kabila introduces Rocky to everyone at the house. Later, Zakir makes fun of Rocky, which leads Rocky to complain to Kabila.

videos.title: Episode 61
videos.overview: Zakir and Habu plan not to let Rocky sleep in the room, while Rocky enters Pasha Bhai’s room without permission. Meanwhile, Bachchu Bhai offers Habu a job worth 100,000 taka, and after Pasha misbehaves with Rocky, Rocky seeks justice from Kabila.

videos.title: Episode 62
videos.overview: Pasha Bhai welcomes Zayef into his room and offers him juice, while Zakir teases Rocky. Meanwhile, Pasha shows Nehal the design of an underworld boxer, Shirin Khala talks to Sporsho about her brother Tarek’s behavior, and Lovely Buya gets caught by Pasha while sneaking powdered milk.

videos.title: Episode 63
videos.overview: Rocky complains to Kabila that Zakir keeps teasing him, while Habu talks to Pasha Bhai and Zakir about possible job offers. Meanwhile, Nehal and Kabila approach Bachchu Bhai for a job, and Rocky gets caught eating Pasha Bhai’s dates and nuts.

videos.title: Episode 64
videos.overview: Zakir treats everyone in the house with sweets, claiming it’s for his passport. Meanwhile, Habu tries to convince Bachchu Bhai to get Nehal and Kabila to join the job, Rocky wants to sleep in Pasha Bhai’s room at night, and Motlub returns 100 taka to Nehal, while Habu scolds everyone at the dining table for hesitating to join the job.

videos.title: Episode 65
videos.overview: Everyone at LogeAchi.com is worried about the job Habu has landed. Upset by everyone’s comments, Habu behaves rudely, and through his aunt, Kabila asks him not to take the job.

videos.title: Episode 66
videos.overview: With Rokeya’s cousin Rocky staying at the house, everyone gets annoyed by his constant antics. Meanwhile, Zakir tries to befriend Sporsho by keeping Zayef happy.

videos.title: Episode 67
videos.overview: Pasha sends Motlub out to deliver boxers but doesn’t give him rickshaw fare, and Motlub later claims he lost the money while walking back. Meanwhile, Habu meets Bachchu and gets his job confirmed.

videos.title: Episode 68
videos.overview: Habu’s appointment letter arrives at the house, bringing mixed reactions from everyone. Meanwhile, Pasha Bhai spends the entire day at Bachchu’s farmhouse, pushing for an underworld investment.

videos.title: Episode 69
videos.overview: After learning from Nehal, Zakir starts dressing up smartly all the time. Meanwhile, Lovely Khala cooks payesh to congratulate Habu on his new job, and on the way back from the market, Habu and the uncle run into Shuvo’s friend Masta.

videos.title: Episode 70
videos.overview: Everyone gets annoyed when Masta suddenly shows up at the house, and the bachelors discuss whether they should let him stay. When Nehal informs Shuvo, he says he had no idea Masta would come to the house.

videos.title: Episode 71
videos.overview: Rocky keeps annoying everyone at the bachelor house. To lighten the mood, the uncle suggests taking all the bachelors out for a trip.

videos.title: Episode 72
videos.overview: Sporsho has been dealing with personal problems for a few days and starts behaving rudely with everyone. Nehal learns about her situation and tries to help resolve the issue.

videos.title: Episode 73
videos.overview: Shuvo’s friend Masta keeps bullying everyone at the house, while Kabila gets annoyed with Rocky’s odd workouts and overeating. Meanwhile, Sporsho brings her ex-boyfriend to the bachelor house.

videos.title: Episode 74
videos.overview: The bachelors team up to teach Sporsho’s ex-boyfriend a lesson, leaving her happy. Meanwhile, Rocky wears Pasha Bhai’s boxer without permission, so Pasha deducts the cost from the house rent.

videos.title: Episode 75
videos.overview: The bachelors come up with a plan to get Masta out of the house. As part of the plan, Pasha Bhai starts annoying him to make him leave.

videos.title: Episode 76
videos.overview: The whole house is excited about going on a trip, and Motlub arrives asking Habu to take him along. Meanwhile, Masta gets scared and runs away after his lungi keeps going missing.

videos.title: Episode 77
videos.overview: Everyone at the house starts planning a trip to a resort. The excitement builds as they discuss and prepare for the outing together.

videos.title: Episode 78
videos.overview: Everyone discusses how Kakhi can manage to go on the resort trip with her leg pain. In the end, they all decide to take her along on the outing.

videos.title: Episode 79
videos.overview: Everyone goes to the resort, with the uncle and aunt, Sporsho and Zayef, and the bachelors staying in their respective villas. Hearing a quarrel in the neighboring villa, the bachelors go to check it out.

videos.title: Episode 80
videos.overview: After enjoying their trip to the resort, everyone returns home satisfied. When Habu invites Bachchu Bhai to join them, he comes along as well.

videos.title: Episode 81
videos.overview: At The Palace, everyone—including the uncle, aunt, and Bachchu Bhai—gathers for dinner and conversation. Meanwhile, Arefin argues with Mehu over skipping dinner, and later Sporsho, Nehal, and Kabila hang out while Kabila also talks with Rokeya.

videos.title: Episode 82
videos.overview: At night, Arefin visits Kabila’s villa for a hangout, while the bachelors chat with Bachchu Bhai and meet Arefin for the first time on a video call with Shuvo. Amid Arefin and Mehu’s argument and various moments around The Palace, Sporsho and Nehal realize Zayef is missing and inform Kabila.

videos.title: Episode 83
videos.overview: Everyone joins in to search for Zayef, and a resort staff member eventually brings him back safely. Later, the group enjoys lunch hosted by the uncle, while Habu, Bachchu Bhai, and Pasha Bhai discuss underworld investments by the pool before being interrupted.

videos.title: Episode 84
videos.overview: Lovely Khala asks Bachchu Bhai about giving money, while he later scolds Malu Dalal and the gunman; the trip continues with happy moments for everyone. Amid this, Arefin opens up about his divorce, leading to a discussion with Mehu, and the group finally heads back to Dhaka after the resort trip.

videos.title: Episode 85
videos.overview: Habu gives Motlub money for groceries, while Lovely Buya refuses to clean Pasha Bhai’s room. Meanwhile, Kabila and Nehal discuss Halim over a video call with Shuvo, as Pasha takes Rocky out for a delivery with promises of food, and Habu cooks noodles for Zayef.

videos.title: Episode 86
videos.overview: Pasha Bhai falls sick during a delivery with Rocky but recovers after returning home, while Rocky later complains about him to Kabila and Habu dismisses it as an act. Meanwhile, Pasha and Zakir plan to use Habu to get money from Bachchu Bhai, as various funny incidents unfold around the house.

videos.title: Episode 87
videos.overview: Pasha Bhai advises Habu to invest in a DPS, while Rocky creates chaos over food and complains to everyone, even prompting Kabila to react. Meanwhile, Pasha, Zakir, and Habu plan to get Rocky out of the house, as Jubayer Halim arrives and meets Motlub at the gate.

videos.title: Episode 88
videos.overview: Halim meets Kabila and the others at the house for the first time, while Pasha Bhai and the uncle relax after deliveries and recover his stolen shoes from a thief. Meanwhile, Habu and Zayef’s conversation turns chaotic with Zakir’s arrival, and Rocky and Halim create trouble in the kitchen.

videos.title: Episode 89
videos.overview: Rocky gets upset after being called “Gojar,” sparking fresh drama in the bachelor house. Meanwhile, the gang deals with jobs, money, and daily chaos, while Bachchu Bhai heads out for a quiet walk with Malu.

videos.title: Episode 90
videos.overview: A new dilemma begins in the bachelor house over where Halim will stay. Meanwhile, rising expenses spark tension between Kabila and Pasha Bhai, just as Arefin arrives at the flat.

videos.title: Episode 91
videos.overview: After his divorce news, Arefin moves into the bachelor house, sparking endless discussions and late-night addas. Meanwhile, jobs, marriage talks, and relationship drama bring fresh chaos to everyone’s lives.

videos.title: Episode 92
videos.overview: Kabila and Nehal meet Mehu at a restaurant to discuss the divorce situation. Meanwhile, underworld money troubles, Arefin’s new bonding moments, and Halim’s frustration bring fresh twists to the bachelor house.

videos.title: Episode 93
videos.overview: Arefin’s unusual behavior creates chaos in the bachelor house, leaving everyone worried and involved. As things turn serious, he is rushed to the hospital, and after surgery, Mehu’s arrival brings a new twist to the story.

videos.title: Episode 94
videos.overview: Everyone visits Arefin at the hospital, where plans for a Nepal trip begin. Later, the bachelors inform him that he will also be joining the trip to Nepal.

videos.title: Episode 95
videos.overview: The group arrives in Nepal and enjoys the resort, exploring a fresh environment and new experiences. From bungee jumping to spa and lakeside hangouts, their trip turns into an exciting adventure with surprising new encounters.

videos.title: Episode 96
videos.overview: At the Nepal resort, a new bond forms with Srijon Bhai, leading to dinners, hangouts, and shared moments. But the trip takes an unexpected turn when Kiran’s strange behavior creates a sudden twist.

videos.title: Episode 97
videos.overview: In Nepal, the bachelors quickly become friends with Kiran and each tries to impress her in their own way. But Kiran’s smart and mysterious personality keeps everyone guessing, as she effortlessly turns their every move back on them.

videos.title: Episode 98
videos.overview: The bachelors make the most of their Nepal trip, enjoying breathtaking locations and exciting activities together. But when Arefin suddenly goes missing one morning, the fun-filled vacation turns into a desperate search across the resort and the city.

videos.title: Episode 99
videos.overview: After returning home from their fun-filled trip, the bachelors are shocked to find Zakir and Rocky hosting a party with girls at the house. The unexpected scene sparks chaos, playful confrontations, and a whole new set of hilarious problems.

videos.title: Episode 100
videos.overview: When Zakir and Rocky’s party with girls is discovered, the peaceful atmosphere at the bachelor house is thrown into chaos. As questioning, suspicion, and hilarious misunderstandings unfold, the duo only gets themselves into even bigger trouble.

videos.title: Episode 101
videos.overview: The peaceful morning at the bachelor house is suddenly disrupted by a police raid, leaving everyone shocked. As the situation unfolds, Arefin is taken to the police station for questioning.

videos.title: Episode 102
videos.overview: The bachelors clear up the misunderstanding and work together to bring Arefin home safely. With the crisis resolved, peace finally returns to the bachelor house.

videos.title: Episode 103
videos.overview: The excitement of the World Cup takes over every corner of the bachelor house, bringing everyone together with football fever. As the tournament heats up, so do the fun, rivalries, and unforgettable moments.

videos.title: Episode 104
videos.overview: The bachelors finally decide to organize a Brazil vs. Argentina football match, turning the house into a battleground of football rivalry. As preparations begin, a series of hilarious and exciting incidents keep everyone entertained.
